26:WORKSPACE_DIR=${1}
39:echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] Configure DB connection in $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml..."
40:sed -i 's|localhost:5432/xplanbox|'$XPLAN_DB'|g' $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml
41:sed -i 's|name="username" value="xplanbox"|name="username" value="'$XPLAN_DB_USER'"|g' $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml
42:sed -i 's|name="password" value="xplanbox"|name="password" value="'$XPLAN_DB_PASSWORD'"|g' $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml
44:sed -i 's|"initialSize" value="1"|"initialSize" value="'$XPLAN_SERVICES_DB_INITIALSIZE'"|g' $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml
45:sed -i 's|"maxTotal" value="10"|"maxTotal" value="'$XPLAN_SERVICES_DB_MAXTOTAL'"|g' $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml
46:sed -i 's|"maxIdle" value="1"|"maxIdle" value="'$XPLAN_SERVICES_DB_MAXIDLE'"|g' $WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml
